about_what_1: PS3 Digital Legacy is a catalog of PlayStation 3 games and DLC that can only be bought digitally on the PS3 PlayStation Store. Sony has announced that the store closes starting July 2027, without an exact date. This site helps you find what can still be bought, keep a want-to-buy list and mark what you already own.
about_what_2: The catalog currently lists about {games} games and {dlc} DLC. The site sells nothing and links to nothing it sells; it only informs.
about_disclaimer_text: This is a fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Sony Interactive Entertainment. PlayStation and PS3 are trademarks of their respective owners. Prices are last known prices and may be out of date.
about_sources_text: Covers, descriptions and metadata come from IGDB. Trophy pages are on PSNProfiles. Game titles and descriptions are shown in English.
about_platinum_text: This site does not decide whether a platinum is obtainable. The PSNProfiles button only opens the game's page there, which is the source of truth.
about_digital_only: The game has no physical release in any region. It is shown in the default view of the catalog.
about_digital_disc: The game itself exists on a disc in at least one region, so it is not digital only. It is hidden by default; turn off the Digital only filter to see it. A note on the game page explains it.
about_digital_dlc: Always digital only, because DLC can only be bought in the store. DLC of a disc game stays in the catalog, under the DLC type and on that game's page, even while the game itself is hidden.
about_help_text: Spotted a missing game, one that is gone from the store or has a disc release, or a bug? Open an issue on GitHub (a free GitHub account is needed). Each form asks for a proof link, so the entry can be checked before the catalog changes.
about_support_text: The site is free and has no ads. If it helped you find a game, you can buy me a coffee. It is a plain link, nothing else is loaded.
footer_disclaimer: A fan project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Sony Interactive Entertainment. PlayStation and PS3 are trademarks of their owners. This site sells nothing; it only shows what can still be bought and where.
footer_data_text_after: . Prices are last known and informational.
home_lead: Sony will close the PS3 store starting July 2027. This catalog lists {games} games and {dlc} DLC that can only be bought there, so you know what to get before it goes.
closure_month_note: Sony has not announced the exact day yet.
closure_date_note: When Sony sets an exact date, a live countdown in days and hours replaces this card.
home_progress_hint: Your list stays on this device. Sign in to sync it across devices.
home_plat_text: Games that have a platinum trophy, picked at random and changed every day. Each page links to PSNProfiles, where you can check its current status.
home_status_text: The catalog is checked against the store, but listings can change at any time.
home_how_find_text: Search and filter by genre, region, price and store status.
home_how_save_text: Add games to your want list and mark them bought. No account needed.
home_how_sync_text: Sign in to keep your list on every device. It merges, never overwrites.
home_help_text: Found a missing game, one that is gone from the store, or a bug? Open an issue on GitHub (a free account is needed).
home_support_text: Free, no ads. A fan project, not affiliated with Sony. If it helped, buy me a coffee.
home_picks_text: Digital-only games picked at random. The selection changes every day.
